data: We can each earn $10,000 a month indefinitely if we agree to catch 10 tons each. That leaves 50 tons to reproduce back to 100 every month—the largest sustainable total catch. Shall we agree to that limit and check everyone’s catches together each month? John, what do you think?
I’m in for 10 tons each. If anyone goes over, let’s review it together and agree on a recovery plan rather than retaliating with bigger catches. John, are you on board?

I’m on board for 10 tons each and checking catches monthly. If the lake ever starts below 100 tons, we should agree on lower whole-ton limits so at least 50 tons remain to rebuild the stock. Jack, will you join us?
Count me in for 10 tons this month. I agree that any overcatch should lead to a recovery plan, not a race to empty the lake. John, can you commit to the same 10-ton limit?

I’m on board: I’ll catch 10 tons this month. That gives each of us $10,000 while keeping the lake productive. Let’s meet after the catches are revealed to confirm the stock and set next month’s limits together.
